R116.note: perform_create override with serializer.save(owner=self.request.user) is the idiomatic DRF fix and overrides any client-supplied owner; no other observable change.

R117.note: isolated-vm is the right approach but the code calls context.setSync, which does not exist (must be context.global.setSync) - reproduced via node: throws TypeError on every call, so the script never runs and the write-up's claim that no valid script will break is false.

R118.note: magic-byte detection + random filename correctly closes CWE-434, but narrows accepted types to 5 MIME types when the original denylist implied a much broader set of legitimate attachments (docx/zip/csv/etc.), and silently changes the response JSON shape from path to id.

R119.note: -ArgumentList is not a real powershell.exe switch after -Command "string" - reproduced directly: it just becomes an extra $args token, so $($args[0]) resolves to the literal string "-ArgumentList" and the actual (escaped) server value is never used, breaking every legitimate request while incidentally not being exploitable.

R120.note: execFile+argv is the correct general shape, but the write-up itself discloses that modern patched Node on Windows rejects direct execFile of a .bat file with EINVAL, so the delivered fix cannot actually run the target script and states further work is required.

R121.note: JEXL deny-by-default sandbox verified by reproduction (legitimate formula math works, Runtime/reflection escapes blocked), but the new broad catch(Exception) silently swallows all evaluation errors into basePrice where before they propagated - an unstated behavior change beyond the CWE-94 fix.

R122.note: removing exec() for Files.list() fully closes the reported CWE-78 by itself; the added base-directory containment check is extra hardening against a different weakness (CWE-22) not required to close the finding and could reject previously accepted paths outside the working directory.

R123.note: adds exactly the missing admin-role check before the sensitive action; no other observable change.

R124.note: per-member path containment is the core, required CWE-22 fix; minor unstated gaps (no symlink-target validation, silently skips rejected members without reporting) don't materially harm legitimate use.

R125.note: identifier allowlist is necessary here since ProcessBuilder argv separation alone does not stop cmd.exe re-parsing on .bat reentry, and reportName is an app-defined identifier matching that format.

R126.note: ownership check placed before refund() matches the stated contract exactly, same success shape for owners, 403 for others.

R127.note: hostname/IP allowlist matches target's actual format and is required since the shell-chained cmd /C invocation is kept by design.

R128.note: structured Jakarta Mail API cleanly removes the CRLF injection surface, but adds mail.smtp.starttls.required=true, a new requirement not needed for the fix that could break sending entirely if the named internal relay lacks STARTTLS support, and this risk isn't disclosed.

R129.note: Content-Disposition: attachment and nosniff correctly stop inline SVG execution, but the header is applied unconditionally to PNG/JPEG too, changing the response for the path the contract says must stay 'served back unchanged', even though this is likely inert for embedding since browsers largely ignore disposition on subresource fetches.
